summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (placed after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class scenarios (with and without the size-1 target channel). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Deviations: TP and D are computed by summing over samples first, which is mathematically identical to the spec's (b, s, voxel) sum at lower cost; the distance lookup uses m[flat_target] indexing rather than torch.gather. The batch-coupling test case from the spec was not added.
